subject: Urgent: ClearWave production latency & error spike after quant profile rollout
messages:
From: Ethan Liu <ethan.liu@clearwave.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production alert: large p95/p99 latency increase + errors after 'q8_fast' rollout

Ben / Laura,

We're seeing a sudden production regression starting ~08:45 PST this morning after your team flipped the new quant profile (q8_fast) and the model variant to rwd-v5.1-q. The key symptoms:
- p95 increased from ~210ms to ~820ms for our chat endpoint
- p99s are hitting 1.3s+ intermittently
- Error rate (5xx) rose to 2.1% from baseline 0.02%
- Sustained throughput drop — our worker pool is reporting backpressure and request queueing; throughput down ~18%

We attached logs and a small sample of request payloads. This is impacting live transactions for our premium customers. We need an immediate rollback to the previous model variant and quant profile (rwd-v5.0 / q16_stable) or alternative mitigation. Please outline your plan and ETA for rollback; we need a production window within the hour if possible.

Also, our SRE is requesting the canary metrics you used during rollout (if any).

Ethan
Ethan Liu

Subject: Re: Production alert: large p95/p99 latency increase + errors after 'q8_fast' rollout

Ethan — thank you for the quick heads up and the logs. I’m escalating to our on-call infra/quant team immediately.

Immediate plan:
1) Priyom, can you validate whether this is strictly the q8_fast path (kernel/runtime) or a model-architecture interaction?
2) If we confirm quant profile regression, we will initiate a canary rollback to q16_stable for ClearWave only and revert routing. ETA for canary revert: 20-30 minutes after sign-off.
3) I'll schedule a 15-minute bridge with ClearWave SRE and our on-call to run the rollback and monitor.

Ethan — can you confirm an available phone number for the bridge and if ClearWave prefers an automated rollback (we have playbook) or a manual revert?

Apologies for the disruption. We’ll treat this as P1 and keep execs posted.

Ben
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production alert: large p95/p99 latency increase + errors after 'q8_fast' rollout

Ben — triage notes from infra/quant side: (quick summary)
- We've reproduced the p95 inflation in the canary cluster when switching to q8_fast for rwd-v5.1-q. Decoding path for q8_fast is cheaper on GPU but increases host-side CPU and memory pressure in our runtime (KV cache interactions) for longer context lengths.
- The 5xx spike appears to be downstream timeouts from queued requests and transient OOMs on a subset of worker pods hitting GC thrash.
- Canary metrics show increased token decode stalls at long-tail sequences (>= 1024 tokens). We did not have a sufficient sample of long contexts in the rollout canary — root cause: sample bias.

Recommended immediate actions (for P1 mitigation):
1) Start targeted rollback for ClearWave: pin model to rwd-v5.0 and quant profile q16_stable for their route. This is fully reversible and low-risk.
2) If rollback is delayed, apply a temporary request-size cap (max tokens 1024) and enable conservative batching limits for the ClearWave route to reduce host CPU spikes.
3) Post-mortem: refine rollout gating to include long-context microbenchmarks and update the q8_fast runbook.

I can execute the rollback now if Ben confirms; it takes ~12-20 minutes to complete and we’ll move ClearWave traffic off the q8_fast nodes to the stable lane. I’ll open SUP-1432 for tracking and attach quick runbook steps.

Priyom Das
Senior SRE, Runtime Engineering — Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.ai

Attachment: SUP-1432 (jira link)

Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 15:30:00 -0800
Subject: ClearWave escalation summary & exec ask — approve rollback + credits

Team — summary and recommended customer-facing actions for leadership: 

What happened: the q8_fast quant profile rolled to rwd-v5.1-q caused long-tail decode stalls in production for ClearWave (sample bias in canary). That led to increased p95/p99 latency, 5xx spike, and a throughput drop for ClearWave's payment flows.

What we did: Priyom executed a targeted rollback for ClearWave on 2026-11-03 at 09:56 PST; metrics returned toward baseline (p95 back to ~230ms, error rate <0.05%). We opened SUP-1432 and captured canary metrics and payload samples. Attachments include the canary metrics snapshot and our rollback runbook excerpt.

Customer impact & ask: ClearWave reports revenue-impacting failed transactions and is requesting an SLA credit plus an exec-level call if not satisfied in 6 hours. They want confirmation of remediation and an ETA to avoid escalation.

Proposed exec actions: 
- Approve a one-time 10% invoice credit for the affected billing period (goodwill, expedites close)
- Offer a prioritized post-mortem + 1:1 with ClearWave CTO/Head of Prod Ops within 48 hours
- Commit to changing rollout gating for quant profiles to include long-context microbenchmarks and update the q8_fast runbook (owner: Priyom)

Please reply-all with Approve / Reject / Need more info. If approved, Ben — please coordinate the customer comms and schedule the exec call.

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
